original_study.original_paper_id: Unique ID for this paper. Example: Bruner_ExpEco_2017_amYY.
original_study.paper_file: File name or local path of the original paper.
original_study.focal_claim: Exact focal claim that the agent must test. The agent cannot change this claim.

tasks_info.task_instruction: Instruction for Task1. Example: Conduct an analysis to test whether the focal claim is supported.
Instruction for Task2. Example: Produce one statistical result that is comparable to the original paper's focal result.

original_datasets.name: Dataset name. Example: RiskData.
original_datasets.file_name: Exact data file name. Example: RiskData.dta.
original_datasets.file_path: Local path to the data file, if available.
original_datasets.file_format: csv, dta, rdata, rds, xlsx, json, parquet, or other.
columns: List key variable names if available. If unknown, use not_stated.
original_datasets.notes: Any caveats about the data, such as unclear variables, missing metadata, or required preprocessing.

codebase.code_available: true if original paper source code is available; false otherwise.

files.file_name: Source code file name, or null if not known.
files.file_path: Local path to the code file, or null if not known.
files.description: Short description of what this source code file does.
files.entry_file: true if this seems to be the main file to run; false otherwise; null if unknown.

codebase.notes: Overall code notes, such as unclear entry file, dependency issues, or folder structure.

memory_records.path_id: Unique ID for this analysis path. Example: Bruner_ExpEco_2017_amYY_path01.
memory_records.case_id: ID of the paper or case.
memory_records.path_summary: Short summary of the analysis path.

controls: List of control variables, or empty list.
path_signature.sample_restriction: Sample inclusion or exclusion rule, or null.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Missing data handling rule, or null.
path_signature.variable_construction: How the main variables are created or changed before analysis, or null.
path_signature.inference_rule: How the result will be judged.

memory_records.status_reason: Short reason explaining why this status was assigned.

allowed_actions: Inspect original paper source code if available.
Use shared memory to avoid repeated paths.
Propose exactly one new analysis path.
not_allowed_actions: Do not change the focal claim.
Do not output multiple candidate paths.
Do not propose a path that repeats shared memory.
planning_rules.novelty_rule: The proposed path must be different from rejected, accepted, executed_success, execution_failed_retryable, and abandoned paths in shared memory.
planning_rules.output_rule: Return one candidate path using plan_out_schema.json.
